summary: The gauge construction and the computation of the maximal halfspace depth of a simplex fiber are internally sound, but the claimed equivalence with the registered convex-body assertion is not verifiable from the supplied material because that assertion is never stated.
gaps: Assertion 1 refers only to the hypotheses and conclusion of `n2-low-energy-uniform-simplex`, without stating them or defining the body-side quantities needed to identify that conclusion. Consequently the key claims that (3)-(12) are exactly the registered hypotheses, that (25) is the registered conclusion, and that the realization in (30) satisfies every registered hypothesis are unsupported under the stateless verification rules. The proof establishes an exact realization and an equivalence for the displayed fiber-depth product inequality, but it does not establish that this displayed predicate is exactly the omitted registered predicate.
repair_hints: State the full registered convex-body hypotheses and conclusion, including the definitions of the body-side depth quantities, inside the candidate, then verify each hypothesis and every component of the conclusion line by line against the scalar construction.
